about: DISC-B, 162 recordings of 4 activities (standing still removed). 5-fold cross-validation over recordings, stratified by class x subject group {subject 1, subjects 2-4}; each fold repeated with 4 seeds = 20 runs. 'val' (15% of the fold's training recordings, re-drawn per run) is held out of training and only monitored. Batches mix recordings of different (room, day) groups.

not_in_discb_column.about: These recordings are scored in their fold but left out of the DISC-B accuracy column, so that the column covers the same 151 recordings as the released micro-Doppler maps used by the DISC CNN baseline.
